Arpeggiator: Only accessor in API v25 is NoteInput#arpeggiator() — NoteInput is the excluded physical-controller subsystem (Decision 2: an agent has no hands). No other type returns Arpeggiator.
AudioIoDeviceMatcher: Only created via ControllerHost#createAudioIoDeviceHardwareAddressMatcher/createUsbAudioIoDeviceMatcher — ControllerHost is the init-time factory object, never stored as a bridge root, so this is not addressable by path.
AutoDetectionMidiPortNames: MIDI port autodetection config, package com.bitwig.extension.controller (not .controller.api — outside the bridge's resolvable package set). Physical-controller subsystem; BridgeExclusions' name filter (Hardwar/Osc/exact MidiIn,MidiOut,NoteInput,PianoKeyboard,MidiExpressions) doesn't catch this name, but it configures hardware controller auto-detection — same excluded subsystem.
AutoDetectionMidiPortNamesList: Same as AutoDetectionMidiPortNames: a list wrapper for the same MIDI-port-autodetection hardware config, outside the resolvable package set and part of the excluded physical-controller subsystem.
BeatTimeFormatter: Only created via ControllerHost#defaultBeatTimeFormatter()/createBeatTimeFormatter(...) — init-time factory surface, not addressable by path.
Bitmap: Graphics subsystem — created only via Host#createBitmap or HardwarePixelDisplay#bitmap (excluded hardware subsystem). No agent-facing use (rendering to a physical hardware display).
ControllerExtension: Extension lifecycle type, package com.bitwig.extension.controller (not .controller.api — outside the bridge's resolvable package set). Instantiated by Bitwig itself to load the extension; not an addressable API object.
ControllerExtensionDefinition: Extension manifest/definition type, package com.bitwig.extension.controller (outside the bridge's resolvable package set). Read by Bitwig at load time, before the bridge exists; not an addressable API object.
ControllerHost: The init-time host/factory object itself. BitwigApiFacade uses it during init to create every other root, but never stores it in BridgeGraph, so it (and everything reachable ONLY through it) isn't addressable by path.
CursorBrowserFilterItem: No accessor anywhere in API v25 returns this type (verified against BitwigAPI25.txt). The bridge's browser navigation uses BrowserFilterColumn + createItemBank instead of a filter-item cursor. Vestigial/unused public interface, not a bridge-specific gap.
CursorDeviceSlot: No accessor anywhere in API v25 returns this type (verified). Device#getCursorSlot() returns the already-reachable DeviceSlot, not CursorDeviceSlot. Vestigial/unused public interface.
DetailEditor: Only created via ControllerHost#createDetailEditor(...) — init-time factory surface, not addressable by path.
DeviceMatcher: Only created via ControllerHost#createInstrumentMatcher/createAudioEffectMatcher/createNoteEffectMatcher/createBitwigDeviceMatcher/createVST2DeviceMatcher/createVST3DeviceMatcher — init-time factory surface.
DocumentState: Only via ControllerHost#getDocumentState() — init-time factory surface. Extends Settings, itself excluded for the same reason (see "Settings").
FontExtents: Graphics subsystem — only via GraphicsOutput#getFontExtents(); GraphicsOutput is a draw-callback-only context object, never returned by any accessor (see "GraphicsOutput"). No agent-facing use.
FontFace: Graphics subsystem — only via Host#loadFontFace(...), an init-time factory surface. No agent-facing use.
FontOptions: Graphics subsystem — only via Host#createFontOptions(), an init-time factory surface. No agent-facing use.
GradientPattern: Graphics subsystem — only via GraphicsOutput#createLinearGradient(...); GraphicsOutput is a draw-callback-only context object, never returned by any accessor. No agent-facing use.
GraphicsOutput: Graphics subsystem — passed into a Bitmap#render(Renderer) draw callback, never returned by any accessor itself. No agent-facing use (rendering to a physical hardware display).
Host: Same object as ControllerHost extends — the init-time factory. Never stored as a bridge root; not addressable by path.
Image: Graphics subsystem — only via Host#loadPNG(...)/loadSVG(...), init-time factory surface. No agent-facing use.
InputPipe: USB/hardware pipe subsystem — superinterface of UsbInputPipe, which chains back to UsbDevice extends HardwareDevice (excluded). BridgeExclusions' name filter doesn't match this name specifically, but it's unambiguously the excluded physical-controller subsystem.
Macro: Deprecated type (API v25); its only accessor, Device#getMacro(int), is also @Deprecated. Superseded by RemoteControlsPage/Parameter, which the bridge already exposes via cursorRemoteControls/projectRemoteControls.
MasterRecorder: Only via ControllerHost#createMasterRecorder() — init-time factory surface. BridgeGraph doesn't currently create/store a MasterRecorder root; a legitimate future extension point, not a wiring bug in the existing roots.
MemoryBlock: Only via Bitmap#getMemoryBlock() (graphics subsystem) or Host#allocateMemoryBlock(...) (init-time factory) — no agent-facing use.
MeshPattern: Graphics subsystem — only via GraphicsOutput#createMeshGradient(); GraphicsOutput is a draw-callback-only context object, never returned by any accessor. No agent-facing use.
ModulationSource: No non-deprecated accessor exists: Device#getModulationSource(int) is @Deprecated, and Macro#getModulationSource() sits behind Macro (itself deprecated/unreachable — see "Macro"). Modulation-source inspection isn't exposed via any live path in API v25.
NoteLatch: Only accessor is NoteInput#noteLatch() — NoteInput is the excluded physical-controller subsystem.
NotificationSettings: Only via ControllerHost#getNotificationSettings() — init-time factory surface.
OutputPipe: USB/hardware pipe subsystem — superinterface of UsbOutputPipe, which chains back to UsbDevice extends HardwareDevice (excluded). Same reasoning as "InputPipe".
Path: Graphics subsystem — only via GraphicsOutput#copyPath()/copyPathFlat(); GraphicsOutput is a draw-callback-only context object, never returned by any accessor. No agent-facing use.
Pattern: Graphics subsystem — common supertype of GradientPattern/MeshPattern, never itself directly returned. No agent-facing use (see "GradientPattern"/"MeshPattern").
Pipe: USB/hardware pipe subsystem — common supertype of the UsbPipe/UsbInputPipe/UsbOutputPipe/InputPipe/OutputPipe family, which chains back to UsbDevice extends HardwareDevice (excluded). Same reasoning as "InputPipe".
Preferences: Only via ControllerHost#getPreferences() — ControllerHost is the init-time factory object, never stored as a bridge root, so this is not addressable by path. Extends Settings (see "Settings").
PrimaryDevice: Deprecated type with zero accessors anywhere in API v25 (verified against BitwigAPI25.txt) — superseded by CursorDevice/PinnableCursorDevice, which the bridge already exposes as the cursorDevice root.
RemoteConnection: Only ever a parameter to ConnectionEstablishedCallback (an observer callback) — never returned by any accessor, so never obtainable via path resolution.
Renderer: Graphics subsystem — a draw-callback interface implemented by the caller and passed to Bitmap#render(Renderer); never returned by any accessor. No agent-facing use.
SettableStringArrayValue: No accessor anywhere in API v25 returns this type (verified) — every StringArrayValue-returning accessor (pageNames, discreteValueNames, contentTypeNames, slotNames) returns the read-only StringArrayValue, never the settable variant. Vestigial/unused public interface.
Setting: Settings' base interface for its individual setting objects (category/label accessors) — never itself directly returned by any accessor; only reachable via the unreachable Settings chain (see "Settings").
Settings: Only ever an ancestor of Preferences/DocumentState (both ControllerHost-only init-time factory surfaces, see those entries) — never itself directly returned by any accessor.
Signal: Only via Settings#getSignalSetting(...), and Settings is unreachable (see "Settings") — an init-time-factory-only chain.
SpecificDevice: No accessor anywhere in API v25 returns this type (verified) — Device#createSpecificBitwigDevice/createSpecificVst2Device/createSpecificVst3Device return the separate, already-reachable SpecificBitwigDevice/SpecificPluginDevice interfaces instead. Vestigial/unused public interface.
TextExtents: Graphics subsystem — only via GraphicsOutput#getTextExtents(...); GraphicsOutput is a draw-callback-only context object, never returned by any accessor. No agent-facing use.
TrackBankFlatteningMode: Documented in docs/bitwig_docs/BitwigAPI25.txt (TrackBank#setFlatteningMode) but does not exist in the compiled com.bitwig:extension-api:25 jar this build compiles against — verified absent from the jar's class list, and the compiled TrackBank interface has no setFlatteningMode method. A docs/jar version mismatch, not a bridge-reachability gap.
UsbConfigurationMatcher: Hardware/USB device-matcher config type, package com.bitwig.extension.controller (not .controller.api — outside the bridge's resolvable package set). Physical-controller subsystem the name filter doesn't catch by name.
UsbDevice: USB/hardware subsystem — extends HardwareDevice (excluded) directly. BridgeExclusions' name filter doesn't match "UsbDevice" itself, but it is unambiguously the excluded physical-controller subsystem.
UsbDeviceMatcher: Hardware/USB device-matcher config type, package com.bitwig.extension.controller (outside the bridge's resolvable package set). Physical-controller subsystem the name filter doesn't catch by name.
UsbEndpointMatcher: Hardware/USB device-matcher config type, package com.bitwig.extension.controller (outside the bridge's resolvable package set). Physical-controller subsystem the name filter doesn't catch by name.
UsbInputPipe: USB/hardware pipe subsystem — chains back to UsbDevice extends HardwareDevice (excluded). Same reasoning as "InputPipe".
UsbInterface: USB/hardware subsystem — only reachable via UsbDevice#iface(int), and UsbDevice extends HardwareDevice (excluded). Same reasoning as "UsbDevice".
UsbInterfaceMatcher: Hardware/USB device-matcher config type, package com.bitwig.extension.controller (outside the bridge's resolvable package set). Physical-controller subsystem the name filter doesn't catch by name.
UsbMatcher: Hardware/USB device-matcher config type, package com.bitwig.extension.controller (outside the bridge's resolvable package set). Physical-controller subsystem the name filter doesn't catch by name.
UsbOutputPipe: USB/hardware pipe subsystem — chains back to UsbDevice extends HardwareDevice (excluded). Same reasoning as "InputPipe".
UsbPipe: USB/hardware pipe subsystem — only reachable via UsbInterface#pipe(int), which chains back to UsbDevice extends HardwareDevice (excluded). Same reasoning as "UsbDevice".
UserControlBank: Only via ControllerHost#createUserControls(...)/createUserControlsSection(...) (the latter @Deprecated) — init-time factory surface. BridgeGraph doesn't currently create/store a UserControlBank root; a legitimate future extension point, not a wiring bug in the existing roots.
SettableColorValue#set: The Color-typed overload (set(Color)) isn't invocable — Color is a concrete class with no bridge accessor producing an instance and no JSON-literal coercion. Not a real gap: the same interface's set(float,float,float) and set(float,float,float,float) overloads (both already reachable/invocable) provide full equivalent RGB/RGBA color-setting via bw_call.
